about: Hybrid companions for admin-root rotations (flagship/admin-root-rotation/v2) and device capability grants (flagship/device-capability-grant/v2). Every port must build `rotation.canonical` from `rotation.fields` and `rotation.newRootKeyId`, and each grant's `canonical` from its fields, byte for byte; verify every case with its gate (bindings from `bindings`, verified with role and subject as named, `now` = `now`) and get `expect`. The ML-DSA halves are deterministic (rnd = 0^32), so a port that re-signs with the signer seeds reproduces everything after the first 128 hex characters of each signature.

rotationCases.name: strict: old root's hybrid signature naming the new root's binding
compatibility: a companion that is sent still verifies
new root's binding swapped for one naming another ML-DSA key
signed by the new root instead of the old
one bit of the signature flipped
strict: the verifier holds no binding for the old root
compatibility: no binding for the old root
new root's binding names another account

grantCases.name: admin grant, admin root's companion, strict
binding of another key than the signer
strict: no binding for the signer
